```yaml
name: Update Lint Config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Mondays at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download upstream lint config
        id: download
        run: |
          set -e
          UPSTREAM_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/main/.golangci.yml"
          curl -L -o .golangci.yml.tmp "$UPSTREAM_URL"
          if ! diff .golangci.yml .golangci.yml.tmp > /dev/null; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Update lint config if changed
        if: steps.download.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          set -e
          # Replace the local config with the upstream one
          mv .golangci.yml.tmp .golangci.yml

          # Configure git
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          # Create a new branch
          BRANCH="update-lint-config-$(date +%s)"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

          # Commit changes
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config with upstream changes"

          # Push branch
          git push origin "$BRANCH"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.download.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const branch = 'update-lint-config-' + Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
            const title = 'chore: update lint config with upstream changes';
            const body = 'This PR updates the local `.golangci.yml` to match the latest upstream configuration from Terragrunt.';
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              head: branch,
              base: 'main',
              body,
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
```
